items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-20
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Did he play with Johnny Wiggs, Johnny Honigman? ... [INTERVIEWEE] No.

ctx.x: That's where we got our education in piano playing. Really? And faking. There was three piano players down there. Piano player never stopped. So they had to hire extra piano players. Okay. And there was Frank Bonero. I got that name on the tip of my tongue. He was, he was sort of a Spanish, he was a great arranger for Spanish music.
Was he, uh, Noem was well enough. Did he play with Johnny Wiggs, Johnny Honigman? No, uh-uh.
